name: Duniverse first-quadrant city boundaries
coordinate_reference_note: Official source-map pixel coordinates; origin at top-left; x east, y south.

generation.method: Province-constrained multi-source least-cost partition. Steep local relief and mapped river cells increase crossing cost; a fixed smooth noise field supplies restrained irregularity. The map draws only the Q1 portion; full-province partitions keep later quadrant boundaries consistent.
